description: A makerspace needs to know which members are certified on which machines, who is due for re-training, and which certifications are temporary, expired, or limited to supervised use. All spaces and member names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 34-year-old makerspace manager balancing open access with machine safety
user_profile.context: The certification process exists, but the current status of several members is no longer obvious from scattered training records
user_profile.communication_style: Safety-minded and status-oriented, wants machine permissions tied clearly to each member

fact_sheet.fact: Kenji Tanaka is an active member of SparkForge Labs with Member ID M-123.
Priya Sharma is an active member of SparkForge Labs with Member ID M-456.
Javier 'Javi' Rodriguez is an active member of SparkForge Labs with Member ID M-789.
Kenji Tanaka (M-123) holds certification C-CNC-009 for the 'Tormach PCNC 440 Mill' (ID: CNC-01).
Priya Sharma (M-456) holds certification C-LC-011 for the 'Helios 100W Laser Cutter' (ID: LC-01).
Javier Rodriguez (M-789) holds certification C-TS-007 for the 'SawStop Table Saw' (ID: TS-01).
Aisha Al-Farsi (M-555) holds a temporary certification C-WD-004-T for the 'WeldPro TIG Welder' (ID: WD-01).
Kenji Tanaka (M-123) also holds certification C-3DP-018 for the 'ForgePrint Resin Printer' (ID: 3DP-02).
Javier Rodriguez (M-789) holds certification C-LC-015 for the 'Helios 100W Laser Cutter' (ID: LC-01).
The certification C-CNC-008 for the 'Tormach PCNC 440 Mill', previously held by member Leo Grant (M-246), is marked as 'Inactive' due to membership lapse.
Priya Sharma (M-456) holds certification C-3DP-022 for the 'ForgePrint Resin Printer' (ID: 3DP-02).
Certification C-CNC-009 held by Kenji Tanaka (M-123) is active and has a renewal date of 2025-06-01.
Certification C-LC-011 held by Priya Sharma (M-456) expired on 2024-07-31.
The certification C-TS-007 for Javier Rodriguez (M-789) is currently active and requires re-training every 24 months.
Aisha Al-Farsi's temporary certification C-WD-004-T for the TIG welder is valid until 2024-09-30.
Priya Sharma's certification C-3DP-022 for the 'ForgePrint Resin Printer' is limited to 'Supervised Use Only'.
The designated supervisor for 'Supervised Use Only' certifications on the 'ForgePrint Resin Printer' is Sam Chen, Lead Technician.
Javier Rodriguez's certification C-LC-015 for the 'Helios 100W Laser Cutter' is due for re-training by 2024-12-31.
A 'Level 2' certification is required to operate the 'Tormach PCNC 440 Mill' (ID: CNC-01) without supervision; Kenji Tanaka (M-123) holds this level.
A mandatory re-training session for the 'SawStop Table Saw' (ID: TS-01) is scheduled for 2024-09-15 from 10:00 AM to 11:30 AM.
The reason for the mandatory 'SawStop Table Saw' re-training is the installation of a new 'DustSentry' dust collection system on 2024-09-02.
Priya Sharma (M-456) is registered for the laser cutter re-certification class on 2024-09-10 at 6:00 PM to renew her expired C-LC-011 certification.
The next basic safety orientation for new members is scheduled for 2024-10-01, conducted by Safety Officer Dana Kowalski.
Use of the 'WeldPro TIG Welder' (ID: WD-01) requires a pre-use safety checklist (Form SF-WD-03) to be completed and signed by a staff member.
Any member whose certification has been expired for more than 90 days must retake the full certification course, not just the re-training class.
Access to the 'Tormach PCNC 440 Mill' (ID: CNC-01) is controlled via an RFID card reader linked to the member certification database.
The RFID reader on the 'Helios 100W Laser Cutter' (ID: LC-01) will deny access to any member with an expired or suspended certification for that machine.
